intent: A destructive confirmation dialog for removing a resource. The visitor opens it from a danger-zone trigger, sees exactly what will be lost, types the resource name to enable Delete, and gets a clear pending, done or error outcome. The panel grows out of the trigger, and it is the one place a destructive action is confirmed.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries and CSS variables on the root
stack.animation: motion/react: animate() on the panel (clip-path circle, scale, opacity), stagger() for content blocks, useMotionValue and animate() for ledger counts, AnimatePresence for the confirm label and the match tick

layout.root: @container, relative, isolate, min-height 640px, centred, transparent, padding 16px / 32px
layout.card: max 560px wide, radius 16px, padding 20px (24px from @md); flex row from @md with the trigger at the end
layout.panel: absolute, centred on both axes via translate, width min(460px, 100% - 2rem), radius 18px, padding 24px (28px from @md), z-index above the scrim
layout.ledger: definition list with hairline rules; each row label left, mono figure right
layout.footer: Cancel and Delete first in the DOM. From @lg one row: Archive instead left (-12px optical offset), Cancel and Delete right, Delete min-width 168px so its states never resize it. Below @lg: Cancel + Delete full width (Delete fills), Archive instead centred under them. Below @xs: Delete stacked over a full-width Cancel.
layout.errorLine: no reserved line: the kicker cross-fades to the error copy, so an error never moves anything

typography.title: display face 24px, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -0.03em
typography.ledger: label 13.5px body colour; figure mono 13.5px tabular numerals

color.approach: one destructive accent per tone; everything else monochrome
color.dark: card #121214, panel #161618, field #0e0e10, hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.08), ink #f4f4f5, body #b4b4bc, muted #8a8a93, scrim rgba(0,0,0,0.62), success #5cb86f
color.light: card and panel #ffffff, field #f6f6f7, hairline rgba(24,24,27,0.10), ink #18181b, body #3f3f46, muted #6b6b74, scrim rgba(18,18,20,0.42), success #2f7d43
color.danger: fill #d63b40 with white text; ink #ff8b8f on dark, #b91c1c on light; wash 10% dark, 7% light
color.neutral: fill is the theme ink with the inverse text; ink is the same ink
color.rule: no warning triangle, no gradient, no tinted surfaces beyond the tone wash

motion.open: panel clip-path circle grows from radius 0 at the trigger centre to 960px over 500ms on [0.22,1,0.36,1]; scale 0.965 to 1 from the same origin; opacity 0.5 to 1
motion.content: blocks rise 8px with 4px blur clearing, 420ms each, staggered 50ms from 140ms, in reading order
motion.figures: ledger numbers count up from zero over 700ms each time the dialog opens
motion.close: the same circle shrinks back into the trigger over 260ms on [0.4,0,1,1]; the panel hides only when that run finishes and is still current
motion.pending: label cross-fades to a spinner while onConfirm's promise is unsettled; button width is locked
motion.done: check path draws in over 340ms, holds for 520ms, then the dialog closes and focus returns to the trigger
motion.error: panel shakes x [0,-3,3,-2,2,-1,0] over 340ms; the label reads “Couldn’t delete” and the kicker cross-fades to “Couldn’t delete. Nothing was removed.” in the tone ink for 2.6s; typed name is kept
motion.reducedMotion: no clip, scale, rise or shake; 150ms opacity fades; figures set immediately; spinner stops

responsive.panel: min(460px, 100% - 2rem) so it fits a 320px viewport; the footer is laid out per container width (@lg row, then stacked) rather than wrapping
responsive.card: stacks the trigger under the copy below @md
responsive.touch: every control is at least 40px tall; the field is 44px

behaviour.match: Delete enables when the trimmed field equals resourceName; a green check appears at the field's right edge
behaviour.enter: Enter in the field runs Delete only when it is enabled
behaviour.dismiss: Cancel, Escape, a click on the scrim and a finished delete close the dialog and return focus to the trigger; nothing closes while a delete is pending
behaviour.focus: field focused on open, or Cancel when typing is off; Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside the dialog
behaviour.page: the card is inert while open and page scroll is locked
behaviour.archive: calls onArchive; closes when a returned promise resolves

accessibility: role=dialog with aria-modal=true, labelled by the title and described by the body
polite live region announces deleting, deleted, the error and archive failures
focus trap with Tab and Shift+Tab; Escape dismisses; focus returns to the trigger
spinner and drawn icons are aria-hidden; the focus ring is a 2px keyboard-only outline
disabled controls are 40% opacity with a not-allowed cursor

copy.title: Delete {resourceName}
copy.body: This removes the project and everything inside it. There is no recovery window and no undo.

avoid: a red warning triangle or any alarm icon
a generic 'Are you sure?' with two buttons and no information about what is lost
enabling Delete from a click alone when typing is required
closing the dialog while a delete is still in flight
a second accent colour, gradients, glass blur, glow or decorative pills
a portal library: the dialog positions inside its container, and the usage note explains how to lift it
animating button opacity through a stagger container with fill mode both, which pins it and ignores :disabled
